title: AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look what AI just did in high energy physics — it’s changing the game.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This breakthrough is happening now, right in the labs of top research institutions.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI agents can now run complex HEP analysis tasks without human input.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They use large language models to automate data processing and anomaly detection.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Physicists at CERN are already testing these systems on real particle collision data.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This means faster discoveries and less human bias in analyzing cosmic events.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever wondered what AI could do in the most advanced science labs?
